body.subject: Issue #572 progress: root report addressing composed; resident delivery rejection and nested suite verdict overwrite reproduced

items.change: Continue successor runs automatically; deliver native turn reports through parent guidance; route unavailable-parent reports to root; recognize self-declared completion through participant_left reason completed and verify/capture/stop at the turn boundary. Remove required_effect_absent, claim-time missing-diff preflight, stall-cycle reaping, and configured loop/stall interruptions. Notify starts waiting seats. Default review and organize permissions permit delegated review and landing. Adopt wake-lead6 root report reconciler and its addressing dependencies. Fix test-runner verdict path inheritance. Start legacy successor continuations at deployment open; independent deployment test in progress.
items.test: Targeted node --test runs; issue572-continuation 12/12; native flow plus issue443 reroute 15/15; runtime API 4/4; runtime effects 7/7; native access and event/observation ports 13/13; phase73 required-effects 6/6; GV4 watchdog 5/5; surface and seam checks; root report + continuation union 18/18; root delivery/addressing/attention 21/22 then sole permission fixture corrected and row green; CLI guidance+notify 22/22; cleanup API/doc 9/9; stall-watchdog 22/22; suite verdict regression red-before/green-after
items.evidence: Real application/MockAdapter tests prove ordinary notification starts one next turn and consumes the pause, explicit done produces a report and completes/stops the worker, and invalid report identities refuse before writing. Missing-effect and automatic stall-stop pins are deleted. Four gate test files: 76 total, 47 pass, 29 existing expected reds, zero unexpected. Worker-verdict C2 fixed and re-run green; its other 13 failures match existing manifest rows.

gates: Root report/continuation union: 18/18 with zero skips
Suite verdict regression: red before dab720e3, green after
environmentRed: The tight-cell and worker-verdict files retain their unrelated manifest-declared expected reds; the changed assertions pass. Full deployment verification was not run, under the operator instruction to run targeted files only.

carriedForward: Supersedes contribution-d492f88acc8925ffcab87d2a501a634c; its main implementation was independently accepted at seq 155085.
Root requested adoption of 81963696; it is merged with its addressing dependencies. Production resident wiring remains owned by wake-lead6.

Rehearsal branch baton/rigidity-lead8-572-root-rehearsal at 275ec0b3 composes production wiring a9a32512 and capability b2f8c29c; old wiring/capability tests 6/6, but new actual turn-report transport test 572-w4 fails root_wake_source_invalid.

The limits integrate attempt finished with integrate_gates_red. Its receipt reports only a nested test-runner-contract child (passed 0/unexpected 1), which cannot establish the outer gate result. The nested runner inherited BATON_SUITE_VERDICT_FILE; dab720e3 isolates that destination and pins it red-before/green-after. No landing claimed. Remote master remains e501507a.
needsFromOthers: wake-lead6: fix rootAttentionPayload to admit turn_reported without contributionId, adopt real transport pin 572-w4 from 275ec0b3, and extend root delivery identity for non-swarm Run turn reports.
rigidity-reviewer7: independently prove legacy continuation starts on deployment open without a command; startup implementation is committed here.
rigidity-571-fixtures: finish wave-driver stop/counter audit and implementation. #571 fixture cleanup is already accepted.
rigidity-568-cleanup: finish recorded external seat-worktree reclamation under #568; first commit covers main seat worktrees only.

root: served resident remains 65c913f0 behind e501507a; the prior limits landing ended with an invalid nested verdict. Runner isolation fix is standalone commit dab720e3 if needed in the redeploy carrier. No full suite run by this seat.
